title: New thread
description: Each process is a fresh launch of P1 on the control session. A sample is a trusted pointerdown on the app's own new-thread control, in the control session's workspace, measured to the settle of the new empty thread: the settle-31-frames rule with an empty destination, where the new-thread view shows none of the control session's rows and the composer is editable. The new thread is discarded untimed, through the app's own delete or left as a draft where the app keeps none, and the control session is shown again before the next sample.

metrics.description: Trusted pointerdown on the new-thread control to the first frame of the first run of 31 unchanged ready frames of the empty thread.
